issue.title: Optional intention-card ghost on today's empty daily note

task_type_fields.proposal:
The intention card (bob-plugins bob-ledger-tools, docs/intention-card.md) paints nothing when a note has none of `intentions`, `summary`, or `reflection`. Add a quiet one-line ghost, for example "＋ set today's intentions  o", on today's canonical daily note only (never on past days, period notes, or `all_time`), whose click or `o` opens the `==` card editor at the intention stage. The ghost must not hide native Properties (it owns no rows), must fail open like the rest of the property-card kit, and must disappear as soon as any field is set.

Proposed scope: bob-ledger-tools intention-card adapter and host mount condition, light/dark/narrow previews, unit tests plus a real-Obsidian e2e check, docs/intention-card.md, then `bob plugins sync -p bob-ledger-tools`.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/period_intentions.md asks the adopt phase to record "an optional ghost on today's empty note" as a follow-up; the shipped card deliberately mounts only when a field is nonempty, and whether an empty-state prompt is wanted is Bryan's call. Proposed by bob-cli-nh.8 note #7; triaged by the bob-cli-nh land agent.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-nh's plan asked to record an optional empty-state ghost for today's note; the shipped card intentionally paints nothing when all fields are empty.
